properties.name: Dump Permits (Brent Run Landfill)
properties.hours: Brent Run Landfill: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM
properties.description: Resident dump permits are obtained free at Burton City Hall - one per household per month, with proof of residency (valid ID or water bill). A permit covers one standard pickup-truck load (under 1,000 lbs) of household materials and is used at Brent Run Landfill in Montrose, which is outside the city limits and so is not pinned on the map. Use Get Directions for the landfill location; the phone number is the landfill's questions line.
